Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.sms

package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.sms
Use cases of the SMS channel: phone enrolment and verification, cost-capped sending of codes and the enrolment query of the SMS second factor.
  • Class
    Description
    ConfirmPhoneUseCase
    Confirms a phone with the code that was sent to it.
    FindUserPhoneUseCase
    Finds the verified phone of a user, which the account API shows masked.
    HasVerifiedPhoneUseCase
    Tells whether a user has a verified phone.
    InvalidPhoneNumberException
    Thrown when the text typed as a phone number is not a valid number.
    PhoneEnrolmentStarted
    Outcome of starting a phone enrolment.
    RemovePhoneUseCase
    Removes the phone of a user, verified and pending.
    SendSmsOneTimeCodeUseCase
    Requests an SMS inside the cost policy: the country must be served and the spending of the window and of the day, including this message, must stay within their caps.
    SmsBudgetExceededException
    Thrown when an SMS is not sent because it would exceed the spending cap of the window or of the day.
    SmsConfiguration
    Declares the policy of the SMS channel as a bean.
    SmsCountryNotAllowedException
    Thrown when an SMS is not sent because its country is not served, or cannot be determined.
    SmsMessages
    Texts of the SMS messages.
    SmsProperties
    Settings of the SMS channel, bound from authserver.sms.* once and validated at startup.
    SmsRefusedException
    Base of the reasons why an SMS is refused before it is sent.
    SmsRequested
    Event published when a text message, whose cost is already recorded within the budget, must be sent.
    StartPhoneEnrolmentUseCase
    Starts the enrolment of a phone: normalises the number and sends it a verification code.
